# Agent Cost Allocator MCP

> Multi-tenant LLM cost attribution for chargeback billing

`agent-cost-allocator-mcp` is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server by MEOK AI Labs.

## Install

```bash
pip install agent-cost-allocator-mcp
```

Or run without installing:

```bash
uvx agent-cost-allocator-mcp
```

## Tools

- `open_ledger`
- `record_charge`
- `tenant_chargeback_summary`
- `full_ledger_summary`
- `product_breakdown`
- `list_ledgers` — List all open ledger IDs + period labels.
